messages:
Hannah (CS): Hey team — starting the Synapse onboarding thread. High-level target: staging integration + 2 pilot flows validated and a go/no-go for PROD within 15 days. Who on Synapse is our main contact for engineering ops?
Maya (AE): Hi — Raj (SRE), Priya (lead infra) and Tori (PM) are the primary contacts. I'll intro them once we lock the kickoff slot.
Diego (CS): I'll run weekly health checks and own the success checklist. Proposing weekly checkpoints Mon/Wed 30m and a Friday retro.
Lina (Solutions Eng): Technical intake items: API keys, SSO metadata (SAML), sample payloads (anonymized), and expected request rates. Can Synapse share a data schema?
Raj (SRE - Synapse): We can provide SAML metadata and a sanitized payload. Our infra has a scheduled maintenance window on Day 9 (GMT 02:00-04:00). Avoid load tests then.
Hannah (CS): Good catch, Raj. We'll put that maintenance window in the timeline. Proposed success criteria: 1) Auth + sample inference call pass in staging, 2) Two E2E pilot flows with <1s median latency under pilot load, 3) Alerts wired to Console and token-level cost visibility enabled. Thoughts?
Diego (CS): Add: ramp plan documented and an agreed baseline cost per 1k tokens for the renewal tracker. If pilot cost >2x baseline, flag for escalation.
Lina (Solutions Eng): For monitoring we need per-route traces and token usage. I'll draft a 1-pager on wiring Console hooks and webhook examples.
onboard-bot: Reminder created: 'Synapse onboarding intake' — please complete tech form: https://forms.example.com/synapse-intake
Maya (AE): Synapse procurement note: internal review at Day 30. So getting to a clean pilot is time-sensitive.
Hannah (CS): Proposed timeline (adjusted for Day 9 maintenance):
```
Day 0: Kickoff + stakeholder intro
Day 1-2: Tech intake (keys, SSO, sample payloads)
Day 3-5: Staging integration + smoke tests
Day 6-8: Pilot flow run + load tests (avoid Day 9 window)
Day 9: Maintenance window (no tests)
Day 10-12: Fixes, monitoring, SLA tuning
Day 13-15: Prod cutover prep + go/no-go
```
Raj (SRE - Synapse): OK for the timeline other than Day 6-8 — prefer Day 7-8 for heavy load so ops can be on-call.
Diego (CS): We can shift load to Day 7-8. Lina, can you validate that prefix caching and KV cache settings can be toggled per-run?
Lina (Solutions Eng): Yes. Recommendation: enable prefix caching only during load runs to improve cost profile, but disable during iterative dev so results are deterministic.
Hannah (CS): Risk register: (1) delayed sample payloads, (2) SSO cert rotation timing, (3) higher-than-expected token costs. Assign owners?
Maya (AE): I'll own procurement/timeline communications. Raj will manage infra windows. Diego will own cost tracking.
Diego (CS): I'll add a renewal-risk card in Jira with fields: baseline_cost_per_1k, observed_cost, latency_sla_ms, owner.
Hannah (CS): Action items: Maya — intro stakeholders (EOD). Raj/Synapse — SAML metadata + sanitized payload (by Day 2). Lina — monitoring guide + config snippet (Day 2). Diego — create Jira "synapse-onboard" epic + renewal-risk card (EOD). Onboard-bot will post reminders.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite queued: Kickoff Day 0 — awaiting stakeholder availability.
Raj (SRE - Synapse): We'll aim to send SAML metadata and sample payload today. Also FYI: production traffic patterns are bursty — expect spikes up to 200 rps for short periods.
Lina (Solutions Eng): That burst info is helpful — we'll run a short spike test in staging. Need to know max sequence length used.
Raj (SRE - Synapse): Typical sequence length ~512 tokens for NLP flows; some shorter analytic calls ~64.
Diego (CS): Noted. I'll model cost baselines for 64 and 512 token profiles.
Maya (AE): I'll confirm stakeholder availability for kickoff and propose Thu 15:00 PST per Synapse preference.
Hannah (CS): Thanks — I'll hold the sync cadence and once calendar is set we'll do Day 0 call and firm up owners. :thumbsup:
Diego (CS): Quick reminder — please anonymize payloads before sharing; PII policy applies.
Raj (SRE - Synapse): Understood. We'll scrub PII and provide samples by EOD.
Hannah (CS): Closing thread for now. I'll update the Jira and ping when done.
